title: Transport a tensor summand followed by a Hom projection
statement: For every scheme X, open U and over-site complexes P,F, suppose e and b satisfy the Hom projection equations. Let d be any isomorphism from T of the local dual to the scheme dual, m a core monoidal structure on L, and c a tensor comparison satisfying the summand equations [lem-pc-ordinary-evaluation-tensor-summands]. For any chain map f and p+q=n, its transported summand followed by the scheme projection equals id tensor d inverse, followed by the forward tensorator, the image under L of the local summand followed by f and its local projection, and the output internal Hom comparison [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections].

proof.text: Use Mathlib HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorMap for the total tensor of d inverse. Postcompose the supplied summand equation hc with c inverse and cancel its tensorator to obtain the inverse summand equation. Apply the supplied hπ at F to move the output projection. Expand degreewise functoriality and L.map_comp and reassociate. This holds for arbitrary f; no local evaluation hypothesis is used.
